t.77-92-9.agn: Also used in food (E330). As a powder or in concentrated form it can irritate the eyes; that is the reason for its EU classification.
t.77-92-9.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 607-750-00-3 (ATP17): STOT SE 3, Eye Irrit. 2.
t.77-92-9.summary: A weak acid found naturally in citrus fruit; industrially produced by fermentation.
t.77-92-9.what: Dissolves limescale, binds metal ions and adjusts the product's pH.
